results.title: InBrief and Top Topics are hidden when no Category Topics or Other prompt exists

steps.title: Given the user opens analysis UZ
steps.testData: UZ = D Postal services (unbranded, FR (FR) + GB (EN), 1 category, 5 prompts Visibility / Competitive only, first collection completed)
steps.observed: /geo/dashboard/714f2985-aa63-4694-8044-a817f0066b60 Overview, Performance tab, date 23 Oct 2026, AI Engines 2, All Countries

steps.title: When the Overview renders
steps.expected: Share of Voice and the landscape table are shown
steps.observed: Sections: 'Share of Voice' (DHL 9%, DPD 9%, UPS 9%, Amazon Logistics 8%, Royal Mail 8% ... Others 29%) and 'Postal services landscape' (10 rows: DHL, UPS, DPD, Royal Mail, Amazon Logistics, Evri, Yodel, FedEx +1, Parcelforce +1, Mondial Relay), then AI Engines Citation Sources

steps.title: Then InBrief and Top Topics are hidden
steps.expected: Neither InBrief nor Top Topics in the Category is on the Overview (no empty state either)
steps.observed: No InBrief block (no 'InBrief powered by AI Sense' image, no '... generated by artificial intelligence' footer), no Top Topics block, no empty state: the PERFORMANCE label is directly followed by Share of Voice (red frame). Headings on the page: Share of Voice, Postal services landscape, AI Engines Citation Sources

steps.title: When the user opens a category of UZ
steps.observed: /category/bfb68153-... Identity tab: Prompts Analysis 'Visibility 3 · Competitive 2 · Category Topics 0', 5 of 5 prompts

steps.title: Then InBrief and Top Topics are hidden at category scope too
steps.observed: Headings: Share of Voice, Brand Prioritization, Package Delivery Services landscape, AI Engines Citation Sources; no InBrief, no Top Topics, no empty state for them (red frame on the performance blocks)

results.notes: Data adapted (dispatch authorisation): UZ = disposable D 'Postal services' (FR (FR) + GB (EN)) instead of 'Car insurance' GB only; the rule under test (no Category Topics and no Other prompt -> no InBrief / Top Topics) holds: GET /v1/reports/{D} topicFeedPromptCounts {overview: 0, byCategoryId: {}}. The wizard Summary had already warned: 'No Category Topics prompts are kept, so InBrief and Top Topics will not be produced.' Previous runs: SKIP (no such analysis in QA-GEO).

results.title: The Competitors card also counts the brands detected in unbranded analyses
results.error: Then not fully verified: the card rose from C0 = 96 to 105 (+9) after D's first collection, while D detects 20 brands (totalBrands) of which 19 could be named via the API and none appears among the 699 brand / variant names exposed for the 11 other analyses. Expected C0 + N; N cannot be established exactly (the API only exposes the top 10 brands per analysis x market x engine), but the visible data point to N close to 20, not 9. Possible bug to qualify.

steps.title: Given the Competitors card of organisation T reads C0
steps.testData: T = QA-GEO, read before D was created
steps.expected: The card is displayed on the GEO dashboard

steps.title: When the first collection of unbranded analysis UN2 completes
steps.testData: UN2 = D Postal services (FR (FR) + GB (EN), 5 prompts, ChatGPT + Gemini)
steps.expected: UN2 rankings list its detected brands
steps.observed: D COMPLETED at about 19:41Z; Postal services landscape lists DHL, UPS, DPD, Royal Mail, Amazon Logistics, Evri, Yodel, FedEx, Parcelforce, Mondial Relay; brand-rankings totalBrands 20; union of the per-market / per-engine top 10 lists = 19 names (DHL, DPD, UPS, Amazon Logistics, Parcelforce, Mondial Relay, Royal Mail, Evri, Yodel, APC Overnight, InPost, Chronopost, FedEx, Sendcloud, Colissimo, La Poste, TSE, Relais Colis, Colis Privé)

steps.title: And the user reloads the GEO dashboard
Then the card counts the brands detected in the unbranded analysis
steps.observed: Card 105 = C0 + 9. The 11 other analyses were unchanged between the two reads (same totalBrands and top 10 lists), so the +9 comes from D. N (brands of D not named by any other analysis) could not be computed exactly; none of the 19 named brands of D appears among the 699 names exposed for the other analyses, so N is expected close to 20, not 9. Red frame on the card.

results.notes: C0 read before creating D (the condition the previous runs lacked). Card semantics question: the card (96) is lower than the totalBrands of a single brand analysis (229 for one of them), so it does not count all detected brands; the +9 does not match D's 7 distinct Competitive placeholder brands either (FR: Mondial Relay, Chronopost, La Poste, DPD; GB: Amazon Logistics, DPD, Royal Mail, FedEx). Dev / PO to confirm what the card counts. Side note: the stored Competitive prompts keep '[Competitor 1] ... [Competitor 4]' in GET /scope, while the category Prompts Analysis shows them filled with brand names.

steps.observed: Manage Scope: Countries 'France - French', 'United Kingdom - English'; Categories 'Package Delivery Services'; pool '1003 / 1050 prompts · 5 selected'

steps.title: When the user adds a category
steps.expected: Fresh suggestions for the new category are shown, all ticked, with the pool in view

steps.title: And there is no Reputation or Brand Image suggestion

results.notes: Data adapted (dispatch authorisation): UA = disposable D (FR (FR) + GB (EN), 1 category instead of 2, no custom Other prompts) - the Add Category rule under test does not depend on these.
